query: insert into media_variants (invitation_id, source_key, variant_key, format, tier, width, height, bytes, created_at) values ($1, $2, $3, 'webp', $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) on conflict (source_key, tier, format, width) do update set variant_key = excluded.variant_key, height = excluded.height, bytes = excluded.bytes, created_at = excluded.created_at
